blocks.text: Source evaluation (source ki jaanch) ka matlab hai yeh check karna ke maloomat kahan se aa rahi hai.

Misal: Sarkari websites aur maaruf (established) news organizations ko reliable (qabil-e-aitbaar) samjha jata hai, kyunke woh apni maloomat durust rakhne ke liye sakht guidelines (usool) par chalte hain. Pakistan mein official sarkari websites qabil-e-aitbaar sources ki misal hain.

blocks.prompt: Exam ki tareekhon ke liye kaunsa source zyada qabil-e-aitbaar hai: board ki official website ya WhatsApp par aage bheja gaya message?
blocks.explanation: Board ki official website, kyunke yeh asal aur zimmedar source hai; forward kiye gaye message ka asal source maloom nahi hota.

items: Source evaluation: maloomat kahan se aayi? Sarkari websites aur maaruf news organizations qabil-e-aitbaar.
